candidate.answerReason: The neighboring angle measures 180°−50°=130°. The angle vertically opposite ∠1 is supplementary to that same neighbor, so it measures 180°−130°=50°. This agrees with the key and the opposite angle's 50° marking in the supplied figure.

methods.label: Use adjacent supplementary angles
methods.explanation: The adjacent supplementary angle of \(\angle 1\) is \(130^\circ\). The vertical angle of \(\angle 1\) is the adjacent supplementary angle of this \(130^\circ\) angle, so it is \(180^\circ-130^\circ=50^\circ\). Thus, vertical angles are equal.
methods.levelReason: The argument uses Grade 7 adjacent supplementary angles and elementary subtraction to explain vertical-angle equality.
